name: quarter
description: Reference quarter of the observation, from 1 to 4
observations: ABS labels each quarter by its final month (Q1 March, Q2 June, Q3 September, Q4 December)

name: series_id
description: ABS time series identifier of the series
observations: Stable ABS Series ID (A-code); the series key, unique per combination of dimensions

name: statistic
observations: Harmonised across ABS workbooks: the same statistic is spelled differently between a release's quarterly and financial-year tables

name: index_type
description: Whether the series belongs to the Import or the Export Price Index
observations: Read from the ABS table title, which is the only place it appears; the same item label is published under both indexes

name: classification
description: Commodity classification the item belongs to
observations: SITC, AHECC, HTISC, ANZSIC, BEC, or a Balance of Payments classification; read from the ABS table title

name: item_code
description: Classification code prefixing the item label, where ABS publishes one
observations: Empty for aggregate items such as All groups, which carry no code

name: item_name
description: Commodity or commodity group priced by the index

name: source_table
description: Title of the ABS table the series is published in
observations: Carried only where a series appears in exactly one ABS workbook, which makes the attribution unambiguous

name: unit
description: Unit of the reported value, as published by ABS
observations: Units vary within a single ABS table, so the unit is carried per row rather than per table

name: value
description: Value of the series in the reference period, in the unit given by the unit column
observations: Carries no fixed measurement_unit: a tidy-indicator column whose unit varies by row and is given by the unit column
